data.value: Every trigger needs a non-empty Id.

data.name: Error_DuplicateTriggerId
data.value: Trigger id '{0}' is used more than once.

data.name: Error_WindowRequirementUnsatisfiable
data.value: Trigger '{0}': an attribute of Window is marked Required but was not recorded, so no window can ever match.

data.name: Error_MinIntervalNegative
data.value: Trigger '{0}': MinInterval cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_PollIntervalNegative
data.value: Trigger '{0}': PollInterval cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_PollIntervalNotApplicable
data.value: Trigger '{0}': PollInterval has no effect with On='{1}', which fires when the element appears or disappears rather than when a property changes. Polling re-reads resolved elements; it does not drive resolution.

data.name: Error_ClauseElementNotApplicable
data.value: Trigger '{0}': a condition cannot name its own window or locator with On='{1}', which fires when the trigger's own element appears or disappears. Every condition reads that element; drop the per-condition window and locator, or watch a property instead.

data.name: Error_ClausesRequired
data.value: Trigger '{0}': On='{1}' needs at least one clause with Watch=true, because the watched clauses decide which properties are observed.

data.name: Error_InvalidClauseName
data.value: Trigger '{0}': '{1}' cannot be used as a clause name. A name cannot be empty, and cannot contain whitespace or any of ( ) ! & |.
data.comment: {0} = trigger id, {1} = the offending clause name

data.name: Error_DuplicateClauseName
data.value: Trigger '{0}': more than one clause is named '{1}'. Clause names must be unique within a trigger, including the positional names given to unnamed clauses.
data.comment: {0} = trigger id, {1} = the duplicated clause name

data.name: Error_Expression
data.value: Trigger '{0}': the Expression is invalid. {1}
data.comment: {0} = trigger id, {1} = the reason, already localized

data.name: Error_UnreferencedClause
data.value: Trigger '{0}': the Expression never refers to the clause '{1}'. A clause the expression leaves out is still resolved and subscribed to while never affecting the outcome.
data.comment: {0} = trigger id, {1} = the clause name that is not referred to

data.name: Error_CustomPropertyIdRequired
data.value: Trigger '{0}': a clause on Property=Custom needs a non-zero CustomPropertyId.

data.name: Error_ExpressionEmpty
data.value: The expression is empty.

data.name: Error_ExpressionUnexpectedToken
data.value: Unexpected '{1}' at position {0}.
data.comment: {0} = 1-based character position, {1} = the token that was read

data.name: Error_ExpressionUnexpectedEnd
data.value: The expression ends where a clause name was expected.

data.name: Error_ExpressionUnclosedParen
data.value: The '(' at position {0} is never closed.
data.comment: {0} = 1-based character position of the opening parenthesis

data.name: Error_ExpressionUnbalancedParen
data.value: The ')' at position {0} has no matching '('.

data.name: Error_ExpressionUnknownName
data.value: '{1}' at position {0} is not the name of any clause on this trigger.
data.comment: {0} = 1-based character position, {1} = the name that was read

data.name: Error_ExpressionTooDeep
data.value: The expression nests more than {0} levels deep.

data.name: Error_ExpressionSingleOperatorChar
data.value: '{1}' at position {0} is not an operator; write '{1}{1}'.
data.comment: {0} = 1-based character position, {1} = the single character that was read (& or |)

data.name: Error_TimeoutOutOfRange
data.value: '{0}' must be a positive duration of at most {1} milliseconds.
data.comment: {0} = option name, {1} = upper bound in milliseconds

data.name: Error_NoElementAtPoint
data.value: No UI element was found at screen point ({0}, {1}).

data.name: Error_DpiUnaware
data.value: The process DPI awareness is '{0}'. Screen coordinates are virtualized, so a point passed to UI Automation resolves to the wrong element on a scaled display. Declare dpiAwareness=PerMonitorV2 in the application manifest, or call DpiAwareness.TryEnablePerMonitorV2 before creating any window.
data.comment: {0} = the awareness mode name (Unaware / System / Invalid)

data.value: The element still answers but is no longer reachable from the window; resolving again.
